name: Peyton Waters
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
episode: The other side of the cove
life: “I still remember delivering a paper to a beach hut that had no number.” People around the courtyard by Ferry Street Rooms know Peyton by a small Sunday habit. Peyton prefers the bench where the sound of the shop door reaches before the visitor does.
voice: I brought the cleaner a newspaper every summer. She let me use her bucket for the sea glass.
appearance: Peyton has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Look for silvery hair gathered at the nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a plum-colored cardigan with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. In conversation Peyton grins on one side while the eyes stay serious.
personality: Peyton has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To return the beach bucket with a picture of its use.
family: Hector Clay is Peyton’s stepsibling. Peyton asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Hector remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The dead man's tab*, Hector says, “He charged me rent for a room he didn't own.”
connections: Warren Ito. The person who used to carry newspapers finds the lettering artist space on the public proof.

reactions.situation: A public donor asks to approve the wording on the bench
reactions.response: Peyton asks the cleaner and the donor for separate views on the wording.
reactions.asWritten: A public donor asks to approve the wording on the bench. Peyton asks the cleaner and the donor for separate views on the wording.

reactions.situation: A cyclist goes down in a crowded crossing
reactions.response: Peyton stays with the rider after the people who saw the fall start drifting away.
reactions.asWritten: A cyclist goes down in a crowded crossing. Peyton stays with the rider after the people who saw the fall start drifting away.

reactions.response: Peyton explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
reactions.asWritten: If accused of favoritism, Peyton explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
